name: Mobile Food Bank
provider: The Food Bank of Western Massachusetts
description: A truck brings free fresh and non-perishable groceries from the Food Bank's warehouse to community sites for same-day distribution. Hampshire County sites include Amherst Survival Center & The Boulders (125 Brittany Manor, Amherst) on the 1st Wednesday, 1:00-2:00 p.m.

requirements.text: There are no eligibility requirements to receive food from the Mobile Food Bank. Anyone can attend.

unknowns: Dates change monthly and some distributions are cancelled; the page advises calling the hotline for closures.
